test_title: PYST 23: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4e5ee7180fb5838fb5d4fcca4a3f8eb91d266b7ca51ac2038e9a1129890c1b6.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +4, -2.

Let's check each option:

1. RD–VB

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e884f7676cd86dab06502ce1d41d0deebbc94ad488f3c1e7280a67365f794e63.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +4, -2.
2. BM–FJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d00625b3ff0e2cea6b2c3a1b3fe28c54de6a6cbb2499ca9391a4558652df6403.png] 

This letter-cluster pair does not follow the pattern +4, -2.
3. QL–UJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1ee5bd48d642f0605937aef79bc7062a3dff121ed96198a46bc9d1421fb3456.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +4, -2.
4. KP–ON

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/728ffd486f1d9895f9612a0cec47e3be5ea77e8c7a48f4f438d04cea9f52e73b.png] 

This letter-cluster pair follows the pattern +4, -2.

Thus, BM – FJ is the odd one out.
Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**"
